[[File:Ghorin2.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Overlord [[Ghorin]] of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]]]]
'''Overlord''' was a rank of [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Ghorin]], ruler of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]], held the rank of overlord.<ref name="XW">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref> The planet [[Demophon]] was also ruled by an Imperial Overlord during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="Supernova">[[Supernova (sourcebook)|''Supernova'']]</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of [[Oversector Outer]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> was also known as the Imperial Overlord of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>
